gates.rule: Use single Server CredentialVerifier for Login C03 and independent NewUser C02 using entered existing account+password. Both require validated credentials, account not suspended and current credential_version; creation-only proof not a login/World grant. No C03 prerequisite for create. Actual private CharacterCreationAccountGuard loggedIn requirement is an implementation gap; authenticated C02 proof is separate from C03.
Region-aware C02 decoded-body; the first/second UI fields are account/password inferred candidates, require native A-027 evidence before production enabling; no account create via Client.

Direct NewUser C02 with existing account+wrong/missing password, nonexistent/banned account, replay or wrong credential version => reject with verified native error and no S02(0), pending, Character or Grant; do not reject solely because C03 was not performed.

A verified creation-only owner proof tied to C02 account_id+credential_version+connection/generation authorizes only matching pending C04; atomic once-only Character commit and C15 pending-only cancellation.

Validate independent native NewUser UI, C02 first/second fields genuine existing Account+Password and original nonzero S02 failure UI; do NOT demand C03(no character)->NewUser callback as prerequisite. Native C02/C04 fail closed until source/profile proven. Private Guard now observed requiring loggedIn and must be refactored after explicit DEV authorization.
C02 S02(0) triggers C04 and state1e; C04 S02(0) goes to local UI, not automatic S03; nonzero S02 leads C15.
Server selects valid map/spawn; Client must accept S15/S14/C35/S04/S33; no invented native C25.
S44/C6C Script lifecycle; Server decides first dispatch and quest rules, close is not completion.

Native Change Password UI must authenticate old/current credential, validate new 4..8, atomically update hash/version, revoke old grants/sessions and preserve Account/Character; admin reset recovery-only. No guessed original opcode.
Identify and verify game's existing password-change UI, original C2S and S2C writer/reader, success/error/cancel display, regional path; no new client and no native-ready claim before evidence.

Design shared-monster life effective damage ledger grouped by party; single highest aggregated team awards full base EXP to every qualifying member plus independent loot-table resolution once each. Party tie/eligibility remains implementation prerequisite. Native packet projection unverified.
Recruiter STATE=REFUSE is domain no-op; no quest/admission/reward/teleport flags and NPC remains repeatable. New click obtains new run/context. Script close alone never quest completes.
